files.markdownlint.yml:
name: Markdown Lint

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

permissions: {}

jobs:
  markdownlint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        id: checkout_repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          persist-credentials: false
          clean: true
          fetch-depth: 1
          fetch-tags: false
          show-progress: true
          lfs: false
          submodules: false
          set-safe-directory: true
          allow-unsafe-pr-checkout: false

      - name: Setup Node.js
        id: setup_node
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: '24.18.1'
          check-latest: false
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Verify Node and npm identities
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $arrNodeCommands = @(Get-Command -Name node -CommandType Application -ErrorAction Stop)
          $arrNpmCommands = @(Get-Command -Name npm -CommandType Application -ErrorAction Stop)
          $strNodePath = [string]$arrNodeCommands[0].Source
          $strNpmPath = [string]$arrNpmCommands[0].Source
          $arrNodeVersion = @(& $strNodePath --version)
          $intNodeExit = $LASTEXITCODE
          $arrNpmVersion = @(& $strNpmPath --version)
          $intNpmExit = $LASTEXITCODE
          if ($intNodeExit -ne 0 -or $arrNodeVersion.Count -ne 1 -or
              $arrNodeVersion[0] -cne 'v24.18.1') {
              throw "Unexpected Node identity at $strNodePath."
          }
          if ($intNpmExit -ne 0 -or $arrNpmVersion.Count -ne 1 -or
              $arrNpmVersion[0] -cne '11.16.0') {
              throw "Unexpected npm identity at $strNpmPath."
          }

      - name: Install frozen dependencies
        working-directory: .github/workflows
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $strContractPath = 'workflow-policy-contract.json'
          $objContract = Get-Content -LiteralPath $strContractPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
          $strExpectedValidatorHash = [string]$objContract.validatorIdentity.sha256
          if ($strExpectedValidatorHash -cnotmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') {
              throw 'The contract did not record a reviewed validator digest.'
          }
          $strValidatorPath = 'Validate-WorkflowPolicy.mjs'
          $strValidatorHash = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $strValidatorPath).Hash
          if ($strValidatorHash -ine $strExpectedValidatorHash) {
              throw 'The policy validator does not match the reviewed digest; refusing to run it.'
          }
          $arrNodeCommands = @(Get-Command -Name node -CommandType Application -ErrorAction Stop)
          $strNodePath = [string]$arrNodeCommands[0].Source
          $arrPreflight = @(& $strNodePath Validate-WorkflowPolicy.mjs --preflight)
          $intPreflightExit = $LASTEXITCODE
          if ($intPreflightExit -ne 0 -or $arrPreflight.Count -ne 1) {
              throw "Preflight identity check failed with native exit $intPreflightExit."
          }
          $objPreflight = $arrPreflight[0] | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($objPreflight.schema -cne 'PSStyleGuide.WorkflowPreflightResult.v1' -or
              $objPreflight.success -ne $true) {
              throw 'Preflight identity check did not succeed; refusing to install.'
          }
          $strManifestHashBefore = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath 'package.json').Hash
          $strLockHashBefore = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath 'package-lock.json').Hash
          # Rooted here rather than read from the contract. The contract's
          # authenticity rests on a constant inside the validator, and the
          # validator is replaceable by the same pull request, so a gate that
          # reads its expectations from the contract can be satisfied by an
          # attacker who replaces both. These literals are independent of the
          # validator and of the contract; keep them in step with
          # supplyFreeze.reviewedWorkingBytes whenever the tuple is re-frozen.
          $strExpectedManifestHash = '59e676d981cffa350cb72e7ea4b1aeec2c49d56621958a095aa0e76733ec2cd9'
          $strExpectedLockHash = '5efc1286025cdc3ad03796c5f4e44cc697e674a30e61de05e299b2a30abad1a2'
          if ($strManifestHashBefore -ine $strExpectedManifestHash -or
              $strLockHashBefore -ine $strExpectedLockHash) {
              throw 'The npm package tuple does not match the reviewed digests; refusing to install.'
          }
          $arrNpmCommands = @(Get-Command -Name npm -CommandType Application -ErrorAction Stop)
          $strNpmPath = [string]$arrNpmCommands[0].Source
          $boolHadCi = Test-Path -LiteralPath Env:CI
          $strPreviousCi = if ($boolHadCi) { $env:CI } else { $null }
          try {
              $env:CI = 'true'
              & $strNpmPath ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
              $intInstallExit = $LASTEXITCODE
          } finally {
              if ($boolHadCi) {
                  $env:CI = $strPreviousCi
              } else {
                  Remove-Item -LiteralPath Env:CI -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
              }
          }
          if ($intInstallExit -ne 0) {
              throw "npm ci failed with native exit $intInstallExit."
          }
          $strManifestHashAfter = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath 'package.json').Hash
          $strLockHashAfter = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath 'package-lock.json').Hash
          if ($strManifestHashBefore -cne $strManifestHashAfter -or
              $strLockHashBefore -cne $strLockHashAfter) {
              throw 'The frozen npm consumer changed package metadata.'
          }

      - name: Validate workflow policy offline
        working-directory: .github/workflows
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $objContract = Get-Content -LiteralPath 'workflow-policy-contract.json' -Raw |
              ConvertFrom-Json
          $strExpectedValidatorHash = [string]$objContract.validatorIdentity.sha256
          if ($strExpectedValidatorHash -cnotmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') {
              throw 'The contract did not record a reviewed validator digest.'
          }
          $strValidatorPath = 'Validate-WorkflowPolicy.mjs'
          $strValidatorHash = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $strValidatorPath).Hash
          if ($strValidatorHash -ine $strExpectedValidatorHash) {
              throw 'The policy validator does not match the reviewed digest; refusing to run it.'
          }
          $arrNodeCommands = @(Get-Command -Name node -CommandType Application -ErrorAction Stop)
          $strNodePath = [string]$arrNodeCommands[0].Source
          $arrPolicyResult = @(& $strNodePath Validate-WorkflowPolicy.mjs build.yml markdownlint.yml)
          $intPolicyExit = $LASTEXITCODE
          if ($intPolicyExit -ne 0 -or $arrPolicyResult.Count -ne 1) {
              throw "Workflow policy validation failed with native exit $intPolicyExit."
          }
          $objPolicyResult = $arrPolicyResult[0] | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($objPolicyResult.schema -cne 'PSStyleGuide.WorkflowPolicyResult.v1') {
              throw 'The policy validator returned an unexpected result schema.'
          }
          if ($objPolicyResult.success -ne $true) {
              throw "Workflow policy validation rejected the tree: $($objPolicyResult.category)."
          }

      - name: Run both Markdown lint surfaces
        working-directory: .github/workflows
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $arrNpmCommands = @(Get-Command -Name npm -CommandType Application -ErrorAction Stop)
          $strNpmPath = [string]$arrNpmCommands[0].Source
          & $strNpmPath run lint:md
          $intOuterExit = $LASTEXITCODE
          & $strNpmPath run lint:md:nested
          $intNestedExit = $LASTEXITCODE
          if ($intOuterExit -ne 0 -or $intNestedExit -ne 0) {
              throw "Markdown lint failed: outer=$intOuterExit nested=$intNestedExit."
          }
files.pull-request-body-identity.yml:
name: Pull Request Body Identity

on:
  pull_request_target:
    branches:
      - main
    types:
      - edited
      - opened
      - reopened
      - synchronize

permissions: {}

jobs:
  verify_identity:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions: {}

    steps:
      - name: Acquire exact pull request head and verified Node.js
        id: acquire
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          if (Test-Path Variable:PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference) {
              $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
          }

          $strServerUrl = $env:GITHUB_SERVER_URL
          $strRepository = $env:GITHUB_REPOSITORY
          $strEventPath = $env:GITHUB_EVENT_PATH
          $strWorkflowSha = $env:GITHUB_SHA
          if ($strServerUrl -cne 'https://github.com') {
              throw 'acquire: the runner named an unexpected server'
          }
          if ($strRepository -cnotmatch '^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$') {
              throw 'acquire: the triggering repository is not a plain owner/name pair'
          }
          if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($strEventPath) -or
              -not [System.IO.File]::Exists($strEventPath)) {
              throw 'acquire: the pull request event is unavailable'
          }
          $objEvent = Get-Content -LiteralPath $strEventPath -Raw |
              ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 32
          if ($objEvent.repository.full_name -cne $strRepository -or
              $objEvent.pull_request.base.repo.full_name -cne $strRepository) {
              throw 'acquire: the event repository identity is inconsistent'
          }
          $strBaseSha = [string]$objEvent.pull_request.base.sha
          $strHeadRepository = [string]$objEvent.pull_request.head.repo.full_name
          $strHeadSha = [string]$objEvent.pull_request.head.sha
          if ($strBaseSha -cnotmatch '^[0-9a-f]{40}$' -or
              $strWorkflowSha -cne $strBaseSha) {
              throw 'acquire: the trusted workflow revision is inconsistent'
          }
          if ($strHeadRepository -cnotmatch '^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$') {
              throw 'acquire: the pull request head repository is invalid'
          }
          if ($strHeadSha -cnotmatch '^[0-9a-f]{40}$') {
              throw 'acquire: the pull request head is not a full commit hash'
          }
          if (@([System.IO.Directory]::EnumerateFileSystemEntries($PWD.Path)).Count -ne 0) {
              throw 'acquire: the workspace is not empty'
          }

          $strResolvedGit = @('/usr/bin/git', '/bin/git') |
              Where-Object { [System.IO.File]::Exists($_) } |
              Select-Object -First 1
          $strResolvedCurl = @('/usr/bin/curl', '/bin/curl') |
              Where-Object { [System.IO.File]::Exists($_) } |
              Select-Object -First 1
          $strResolvedTar = @('/usr/bin/tar', '/bin/tar') |
              Where-Object { [System.IO.File]::Exists($_) } |
              Select-Object -First 1
          if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($strResolvedGit) -or
              [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($strResolvedCurl) -or
              [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($strResolvedTar)) {
              throw 'acquire: a required native tool was not resolved'
          }
          New-Variable -Name strGitPath -Value $strResolvedGit -Option Constant
          New-Variable -Name strCurlPath -Value $strResolvedCurl -Option Constant
          New-Variable -Name strTarPath -Value $strResolvedTar -Option Constant

          Get-ChildItem Env: |
              Where-Object { $_.Name -clike 'GIT_*' } |
              ForEach-Object { Remove-Item -LiteralPath "Env:$($_.Name)" }
          $env:GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS = '1'
          $env:GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS = '0'

          function Add-ProposedBlob {
              # .SYNOPSIS
              # Acquires one bounded proposed blob without checking out its file.
              #
              # .DESCRIPTION
              # Reads the exact head tree and rejects a non-regular or mismatched
              # entry. Downloads an absent blob within fixed transport bounds,
              # verifies its raw Git identity, and stores only that Git object.
              # Invalid input, transfer, identity, or storage failures throw.
              # An existing object needs no transfer; the trusted identity command
              # subsequently validates its size, encoding, and role semantics.
              #
              # .PARAMETER RepositoryPath
              # Fixed repository-relative path from the fixed transfer plan.
              #
              # .PARAMETER MaximumBytes
              # Inclusive role byte limit, between zero and 573440 bytes.
              #
              # .PARAMETER Sequence
              # Unique transfer sequence between one and 24 in this acquisition.
              #
              # .PARAMETER ExpectedBlob
              # Optional exact Git blob identity; null omits this extra comparison.
              #
              # .PARAMETER ExpectedBytes
              # Optional exact download size; null uses only MaximumBytes.
              #
              # .EXAMPLE
              # $longBytes = Add-ProposedBlob -RepositoryPath '.github/workflows/build.yml' -MaximumBytes 131072 -Sequence 1
              #
              # # Returns the transferred byte count, or zero for an existing blob.
              #
              # .INPUTS
              # None. Pipeline input is not supported.
              #
              # .OUTPUTS
              # System.Int64. Transferred byte count for a downloaded blob.
              # System.Int32. Zero when the blob is already present.
              # Failure throws and does not return a success value.
              #
              # .NOTES
              # PRIVATE/INTERNAL HELPER. This function is not a public API.
              # Parameters, return shape, and positional contract can change
              # without notice. All parameters must be named.
              #
              # Version: 1.0.20260914.0
              [CmdletBinding(PositionalBinding = $false)]
              [OutputType([long], [int])]
              param(
                  [Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $RepositoryPath,
                  [Parameter(Mandatory)][long] $MaximumBytes,
                  [Parameter(Mandatory)][int] $Sequence,
                  [Parameter()][AllowNull()][string] $ExpectedBlob,
                  [Parameter()][AllowNull()][Nullable[long]] $ExpectedBytes
              )

              if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($RepositoryPath) -or
                  [System.IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($RepositoryPath) -or
                  $RepositoryPath.Contains('\', [StringComparison]::Ordinal) -or
                  $RepositoryPath -match '(^|/)\.\.?(/|$)' -or
                  $RepositoryPath.IndexOfAny([char[]]@("`0", "`r", "`n", "`t")) -ge 0 -or
                  $MaximumBytes -lt 0 -or $MaximumBytes -gt 573440 -or
                  $Sequence -lt 1 -or $Sequence -gt 24 -or
                  (-not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($ExpectedBlob) -and
                      $ExpectedBlob -cnotmatch '^[0-9a-f]{40}$') -or
                  ($null -ne $ExpectedBytes -and
                      ($ExpectedBytes -lt 0 -or
                          $ExpectedBytes -gt $MaximumBytes))) {
                  throw 'acquire: a proposed blob request is invalid'
              }
              $strTreeEntry = [string](& $strGitPath -C $PWD.Path `
                      --no-replace-objects -c core.fsmonitor=false ls-tree `
                      $strHeadSha -- $RepositoryPath)
              if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or
                  $strTreeEntry -cnotmatch '^100644 blob ([0-9a-f]{40})\t(.+)$' -or
                  $Matches[2] -cne $RepositoryPath -or
                  (-not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($ExpectedBlob) -and
                      $Matches[1] -cne $ExpectedBlob)) {
                  throw "acquire: $RepositoryPath is not the expected regular blob"
              }
              $strTreeBlob = $Matches[1]
              & $strGitPath -C $PWD.Path --no-replace-objects `
                  -c core.fsmonitor=false cat-file -e "$strTreeBlob`^{blob}" 2>$null
              if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
                  return 0
              }
              if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 1 -and $LASTEXITCODE -ne 128) {
                  throw "acquire: $RepositoryPath blob availability is indeterminate"
              }

              $strEscapedPath = [string]::Join(
                  '/',
                  @($RepositoryPath.Split('/') | ForEach-Object {
                          [System.Uri]::EscapeDataString($_)
                      })
              )
              $strBlobUrl =
                  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/$strHeadRepository/$strHeadSha/$strEscapedPath"
              $strBlobRoot = [System.IO.Path]::Combine(
                  $env:RUNNER_TEMP,
                  'pr-body-identity-proposed-blobs'
              )
              [void][System.IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($strBlobRoot)
              $strDownloadPath = [System.IO.Path]::Combine(
                  $strBlobRoot,
                  "blob-$Sequence.bin"
              )
              if ([System.IO.File]::Exists($strDownloadPath) -or
                  [System.IO.Directory]::Exists($strDownloadPath)) {
                  throw 'acquire: a proposed blob download path already exists'
              }
              $longTransferLimit = $MaximumBytes + 1
              try {
                  & $strCurlPath --silent --show-error --fail `
                      --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 `
                      --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 `
                      --speed-limit 1024 --speed-time 15 `
                      --max-filesize $longTransferLimit `
                      --range "0-$MaximumBytes" `
                      --output $strDownloadPath $strBlobUrl
                  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or
                      -not [System.IO.File]::Exists($strDownloadPath)) {
                      throw "acquire: $RepositoryPath bounded download failed"
                  }
                  $longObservedBytes =
                      [System.IO.FileInfo]::new($strDownloadPath).Length
                  if ($longObservedBytes -gt $MaximumBytes -or
                      ($null -ne $ExpectedBytes -and
                          $longObservedBytes -ne $ExpectedBytes)) {
                      throw "acquire: $RepositoryPath exceeds its byte contract"
                  }
                  $strObservedBlob = [string](& $strGitPath -C $PWD.Path `
                          --no-replace-objects -c core.fsmonitor=false `
                          hash-object --no-filters $strDownloadPath)
                  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or
                      $strObservedBlob.Trim() -cne $strTreeBlob) {
                      throw "acquire: $RepositoryPath has a mismatched Git blob"
                  }
                  $strWrittenBlob = [string](& $strGitPath -C $PWD.Path `
                          --no-replace-objects -c core.fsmonitor=false `
                          hash-object --no-filters -w $strDownloadPath)
                  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or
                      $strWrittenBlob.Trim() -cne $strTreeBlob) {
                      throw "acquire: $RepositoryPath could not be stored exactly"
                  }
                  return $longObservedBytes
              } finally {
                  if ([System.IO.File]::Exists($strDownloadPath)) {
                      Remove-Item -LiteralPath $strDownloadPath -Force
                  }
              }
          }

          & $strGitPath --no-replace-objects -c core.fsmonitor=false init --quiet .
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "acquire: git init exited $LASTEXITCODE" }
          & $strGitPath --no-replace-objects -c core.fsmonitor=false remote add trusted "$strServerUrl/$strRepository"
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "acquire: trusted remote add exited $LASTEXITCODE" }
          & $strGitPath --no-replace-objects -c core.fsmonitor=false fetch --depth 1 --no-tags --no-recurse-submodules trusted $strBaseSha
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "acquire: trusted fetch exited $LASTEXITCODE" }
          $strTrustedRoot = [System.IO.Path]::Combine(
              $env:RUNNER_TEMP,
              'pr-body-identity-trusted'
          )
          if ([System.IO.Directory]::Exists($strTrustedRoot) -or
              [System.IO.File]::Exists($strTrustedRoot)) {
              throw 'acquire: the trusted worktree path is not empty'
          }
          & $strGitPath --no-replace-objects -c core.fsmonitor=false worktree add --quiet --detach $strTrustedRoot $strBaseSha
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "acquire: trusted worktree exited $LASTEXITCODE" }
          $strObservedBase = (& $strGitPath -C $strTrustedRoot --no-replace-objects -c core.fsmonitor=false rev-parse --verify 'HEAD^{commit}').Trim()
          $arrTrustedEntries = @(& $strGitPath -C $strTrustedRoot --no-replace-objects -c core.fsmonitor=false ls-tree $strObservedBase -- .github/workflows/Sync-PullRequestBodyIdentity.mjs .github/workflows/pull-request-body-identity-cases.json .github/workflows/pull-request-body-identity.yml)
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $strObservedBase -cne $strBaseSha -or
              $arrTrustedEntries.Count -ne 3 -or
              @($arrTrustedEntries | Where-Object {
                  $_ -cnotmatch '^100644 blob [0-9a-f]{40}\t\.github/workflows/(Sync-PullRequestBodyIdentity\.mjs|pull-request-body-identity-cases\.json|pull-request-body-identity\.yml)$'
              }).Count -ne 0) {
              throw 'acquire: the trusted verifier inputs are invalid'
          }
          $strTrustedCommandPath = [System.IO.Path]::Combine(
              $strTrustedRoot,
              '.github',
              'workflows',
              'Sync-PullRequestBodyIdentity.mjs'
          )
          $strTrustedCasesPath = [System.IO.Path]::Combine(
              $strTrustedRoot,
              '.github',
              'workflows',
              'pull-request-body-identity-cases.json'
          )
          if (-not [System.IO.File]::Exists($strTrustedCommandPath) -or
              -not [System.IO.File]::Exists($strTrustedCasesPath)) {
              throw 'acquire: a trusted verifier input is absent'
          }
          & $strGitPath --no-replace-objects -c core.fsmonitor=false remote add proposed "$strServerUrl/$strHeadRepository"
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "acquire: proposed remote add exited $LASTEXITCODE" }
          & $strGitPath --no-replace-objects -c core.fsmonitor=false fetch --filter=blob:none --depth 65 --no-tags --no-recurse-submodules proposed $strHeadSha
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "acquire: proposed fetch exited $LASTEXITCODE" }
          $env:GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH = '1'
          $strFetchedHead = (& $strGitPath --no-replace-objects -c core.fsmonitor=false rev-parse --verify 'FETCH_HEAD^{commit}').Trim()
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $strFetchedHead -cne $strHeadSha) {
              throw 'acquire: the fetched revision is not the exact pull request head'
          }
          & $strGitPath --no-replace-objects -c core.fsmonitor=false update-ref --no-deref HEAD $strFetchedHead
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "acquire: detached HEAD update exited $LASTEXITCODE" }
          $strObservedHead = (& $strGitPath --no-replace-objects -c core.fsmonitor=false rev-parse --verify 'HEAD^{commit}').Trim()
          $strObservedTree = (& $strGitPath --no-replace-objects -c core.fsmonitor=false rev-parse --verify 'HEAD^{tree}').Trim()
          $arrReplacementRefs = @(& $strGitPath --no-replace-objects -c core.fsmonitor=false for-each-ref --format='%(refname)' refs/replace/)
          $arrProposedWorktreeEntries = @(
              [System.IO.Directory]::EnumerateFileSystemEntries($PWD.Path) |
                  Where-Object {
                      [System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($_) -cne '.git'
                  }
          )
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $strObservedHead -cne $strHeadSha -or
              $strObservedTree -cnotmatch '^[0-9a-f]{40}$' -or
              $arrReplacementRefs.Count -ne 0 -or
              $arrProposedWorktreeEntries.Count -ne 0) {
              throw 'acquire: the proposed repository state is invalid'
          }
          & $strGitPath --no-replace-objects -c core.fsmonitor=false remote remove trusted
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
              throw "acquire: trusted remote removal exited $LASTEXITCODE"
          }
          & $strGitPath --no-replace-objects -c core.fsmonitor=false remote remove proposed
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
              throw "acquire: proposed remote removal exited $LASTEXITCODE"
          }
          $arrOfflineSelector = @(
              & $strGitPath --no-replace-objects -c core.fsmonitor=false `
                  config --name-only --get-regexp `
                  '^(remote\..*|extensions\.partialclone)$'
          )
          $intOfflineSelectorExit = $LASTEXITCODE
          if ($intOfflineSelectorExit -ne 1 -or
              $arrOfflineSelector.Count -ne 0) {
              throw 'acquire: the disposable repository retains a network selector'
          }
          $arrProposedEntries = @(& $strGitPath --no-replace-objects -c core.fsmonitor=false ls-tree $strObservedHead -- .github/workflows/Sync-PullRequestBodyIdentity.mjs .github/workflows/pull-request-body-identity-cases.json .github/workflows/pull-request-body-identity.yml)
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $arrProposedEntries.Count -ne 3) {
              throw 'acquire: the proposed verifier inputs are invalid'
          }
          $boolVerifierInputsChanged =
              [string]::Join("`n", $arrProposedEntries) -cne
              [string]::Join("`n", $arrTrustedEntries)
          $arrOrdinaryTuplePaths = @(
              '.github/workflows/workflow-policy-cases.json',
              '.github/workflows/workflow-policy-contract.json',
              '.github/workflows/Validate-WorkflowPolicy.mjs',
              '.github/workflows/build.yml',
              '.github/workflows/markdownlint.yml',
              '.github/workflows/workflow-isolation-reference.json',
              '.github/workflows/workflow-isolation-validator.reference.txt'
          )
          $arrTrustedOrdinaryEntries = @(& $strGitPath --no-replace-objects -c core.fsmonitor=false ls-tree $strBaseSha -- @arrOrdinaryTuplePaths)
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $arrTrustedOrdinaryEntries.Count -ne 7) {
              throw 'acquire: the trusted ordinary tuple is unavailable'
          }
          $arrProposedOrdinaryEntries = @(& $strGitPath --no-replace-objects -c core.fsmonitor=false ls-tree $strHeadSha -- @arrOrdinaryTuplePaths)
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $arrProposedOrdinaryEntries.Count -ne 7) {
              throw 'acquire: the proposed ordinary tuple is unavailable'
          }
          foreach ($strOrdinaryEntry in @($arrTrustedOrdinaryEntries) + @($arrProposedOrdinaryEntries)) {
